subject: maths
question: A bus covers the first 50 km of its journey in 40 minutes and covers the remaining 75 km in 40 minutes. What is the average speed (in km/h) of the bus?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Average Speed** = (Total Distance) ÷ (Total Time)

**Total Distance** = 50 km + 75 km = 125 km

**Total Time** = 40 min + 40 min = 80 min = 4/3 hours

**Average Speed** = 125 ÷ (4/3) = (125 × 3) ÷ 4 = 375 ÷ 4 = 93 ³/₄ km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 93 ³/₄ km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance₁ (d₁) = 50 km, Time₁ (t₁) = 40 min

Distance₂ (d₂) = 75 km, Time₂ (t₂) = 40 min

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = (d₁ + d₂) ÷ (t₁ + t₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15fcbcc18c2059d0112cfab22a83fce1a8808017c9e53b3f26277957c16feb29.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 50 + 75 = 125 km

⇒ Total Time = 40 + 40 = 80 minutes

⇒ Convert minutes to hours: 80 ÷ 60 = 4/3 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 125 ÷ (4/3) km/h

⇒ Average Speed = (125 × 3) ÷ 4 km/h

⇒ Average Speed = 375 ÷ 4 km/h

⇒ Average Speed = 93 ³/₄ km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 93 ³/₄ km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Definition of Average Speed

Average speed is the total distance traveled divided by the total time elapsed, regardless of speed variations during the trip.

Harmonic Mean of Speeds

If a person covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, then the average speed for the whole journey is (2xy) ÷ (x + y).

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Constant Speed vs. Average Speed

Average speed is not necessarily the arithmetic mean of the speeds unless the time spent traveling at each speed is the same.</p
